title: Tenant admin login fails after onboarding — GET /api/tenant-config?host=127.0.0.1 always returns bpm-default realm; no realm hint mechanism for shared-hostname environments
diagnosis_category_label: Logic error — source is correct per letter of spec, but a missing realm hint mechanism causes the login flow to break on shared-hostname environments

root_causes.label: No realm hint mechanism for shared-hostname access
root_causes.description: OIDC-F-05 and OIDC-F-06 are BOTH implemented: `src/api/routes/tenant_config.zig` exists and is registered in `src/main.zig`; `web/src/auth/tenantConfig.ts` and `web/src/auth/OidcManager.getOidcManager()` correctly call the endpoint on startup. However, the implementation assumes subdomain-per-tenant routing. When Alice accesses the BPM console at http://127.0.0.1:8080, `window.location.hostname` is `127.0.0.1`. The `GET /api/tenant-config?host=127.0.0.1` query finds no row in `tenant_hostnames` (which has a UNIQUE constraint per hostname — multiple tenants cannot share `127.0.0.1`), so the endpoint returns the `bpm-default` realm. The OidcManager is initialised with `bpm-default` and redirects Alice to the bpm-default Keycloak login. Alice's credentials exist in the `swiftroute` realm and are rejected. The missing feature is a realm hint mechanism — a way for the frontend to select the correct realm when hostname-based discovery is ambiguous.

root_causes.label: Onboarding result screen does not provide a realm-aware login link
root_causes.description: The onboarding result screen shows the `oidc_authority` URL (e.g. `http://keycloak:8081/realms/swiftroute`) as informational text, but provides no direct login link to the BPM console that encodes the tenant realm. Alice must know to navigate to the BPM console and has no path to specify her realm without DNS/hosts configuration.

evidence.backend_endpoint_exists: src/api/routes/tenant_config.zig line 1: '//! GET /api/tenant-config?host={hostname}'; registered in src/main.zig line 403
evidence.hostname_unique_constraint: src/design/oidcf2-subdomain-routing.md line 33: CONSTRAINT tenant_hostnames_hostname_uq UNIQUE (hostname) — prevents 127.0.0.1 binding to multiple tenants
evidence.uat_failure: tests/uat-reports/uat-2026-06-16-WF05-swiftroute-onboarding-gui-v3.yaml EO-004 FAIL: page_shown='BPM Default Realm sign-in screen', expected_page='SwiftRoute workspace dashboard'

recommended_fix.approach: Add realm hint mechanism: (1) extend GET /api/tenant-config to accept optional ?realm=<slug> parameter — when provided and valid, return that tenant's OIDC config directly without hostname lookup; (2) update frontend tenantConfig.ts to check URL query parameter `realm` before falling back to hostname lookup; (3) update OnboardingResultPage to render a direct BPM console login link embedding ?realm=<slug>, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080/?realm=swiftroute; (4) frontend on startup reads ?realm from URL, stores in sessionStorage, passes to tenant-config fetch.
recommended_fix.backend_change: src/api/routes/tenant_config.zig — check query_str for `realm` param; if present, query `SELECT idp_realm_id FROM tenant WHERE slug = $1 LIMIT 1`; skip hostname lookup.
recommended_fix.frontend_change: web/src/auth/tenantConfig.ts — before hostname fetch, check `new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('realm')`; if present, call GET /api/tenant-config?realm=<slug> and store in sessionStorage so subsequent navigations reuse it.
recommended_fix.security_note: The ?realm param is read-only config — it does not grant auth, it only selects which Keycloak realm the browser is redirected to. No access control bypassed.

resolution: Implemented exactly as recommended: src/api/routes/tenant_config.zig:62-93 checks ?realm=<slug> first, falls back to ?host=<hostname>. web/src/auth/tenantConfig.ts:28-54 (resolveRealmFromUrl/fetchTenantConfig) checks sessionStorage, then URL ?realm=, then hostname, persisting the resolved value to sessionStorage.
verification: Batch re-triage 2026-08-10 (WF03-batch-GH280-301-triage-20260810): source-verified fix matches recommended_fix exactly. Unit tests pass: npm run test -- buildRedirectArgs tenantConfig -> 5/5 pass (src/auth/tenantConfig.test.ts, src/auth/buildRedirectArgs.test.ts).
